# 07 · Analytics

The GA4 events the flow sends through GTM, what they carry, and when they may be sent. Transitions refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`.

Marks: **[D]** in `docs/04-analytics-notes.md` · **[A]** our rule · **[P]** proposed, not built.

Out of the thin slice (PLAN.md). Built later as one module, below.

## What the docs give us, and what they don't

- Six events, names fixed by marketing ("keep names exactly as written") [D]. Happy path only: no event for a cancel, decline, error or timeout.
- Only `purchase` has params: `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]. Nothing for the other five (Q20).
- "UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`" [D]. No storage rule, and the flow leaves our origin once or twice: eID, then payment (plus `actionUrl` on `requires_action`). Return can land in another browser (Q7).
- No consent mechanism (Q5). GA4 in the EU needs prior consent for analytics cookies.
- `purchase` fired in the browser misses every user who never comes back from payment, and can fire twice (reload, second tab, second browser).
- The order API returns no amount, currency or trial flag (Q4). `value` is our estimate.

## Module

One pure module, `analytics.ts`:

- `track(event, params)`: typed map of the six events → their params. Unknown event = type error.
- Adds the common params, checks consent, applies the once-rules, then `dataLayer.push`.
- Components and state handlers call `track` on the transitions below. Nothing else touches `dataLayer`.
- Unit-tested: params per event, once-rules, consent gate, no personal data.

## Events

Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.

| Event [D] | Fires on (04) | Params (plus common) | Once-rule [A] |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per page load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics) |
| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |
| `identity_started` | **StartingEid —201→ redirect to `redirectUrl`**. Not on click (may 429/fail) | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose`: `checkout` \| `reverify` (reverify = orderId in context, from IdentityLost) | Once per 201. Retry after EidFailed/RateLimited fires again: each is a real start |
| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. Callback route uses `history.replace`, so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |
| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |
| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |

Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback or after 500 ms, whichever first. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.

### `purchase` params

| Param | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |
| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |

No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.

Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).

## Common params (every event)

| Param | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. URL is lowercase |
| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | From the URL path |
| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |

Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.

### No personal data

Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.

## UTM capture and storage

**Capture** [A]: on Entry, read `utm_*` from the landing URL. A new landing with any `utm_*` replaces the whole set (last campaign wins). A landing without UTMs keeps a stored set. Other query params are ignored (`gclid` etc. → proposals).

**Carry**: two (three with `actionUrl`) cross-origin redirects, maybe into another browser (Q7).

| Where | Before consent | After consent |
|---|---|---|
| Memory (current page, client-side navigation) | yes | yes |
| `returnUrl` query, eID and payment (Q7) | yes: URL, not storage (Q5) | yes |
| `sessionStorage` (same tab, after a redirect) | no | yes |

Trust order as 04 invariant 2: stored > `returnUrl` query. On return, the app reads UTMs from the query only when nothing is stored. Without consent, UTMs exist only in the URL, so they survive the redirects but not a manual reload of a page without them.

`returnUrl` keeps the standard `utm_*` names. Side effect: the return page view re-states the campaign, so GA4 doesn't credit the eID or payment provider as a referral. Still needed from marketing: eID and payment domains in GA4 "unwanted referrals" (Q47).

Limits: UTMs add to `returnUrl` length, and the provider/API limit is not documented (02). UTMs reach the eID and payment providers in the URL; they hold no personal data.

## Consent

Assumption Q5: GTM Consent Mode v2, basic mode (no Google tags before consent). CMP vendor unknown.

| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |
|---|---|---|---|
| Consent default | `gtag('consent', 'default', {analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization: 'denied'})` before GTM loads | `update` by the CMP | stays denied |
| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal clears it |
| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |

- Queued events not flushed before a redirect are lost. Accepted: a CMP decision normally happens on Plans.
- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
- The CMP banner counts against the plan page budget (LCP, INP, JS size, Q22).

## Known gaps of client-side events

| Gap | Effect | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (below) |
| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side, deduped by `orderId` |
| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side with the original client id |
| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side for `purchase` |
| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |

## What must move server-side

Requests to Backend + Marketing. Not built; client-side events stay until these exist.

1. **`purchase` from the payment webhook** via GA4 Measurement Protocol, once per `orderId`, with the charged amount, tax, currency and trial flag (Q4). Then the client stops sending `purchase` (or sends it only as a fallback, deduped on `transaction_id`).
2. **Attribution on the order**: `POST /v1/orders` also carries GA `client_id`, `session_id`, the consent state and UTMs (all omitted when consent is denied). Backend stores them with the order and uses them for the Measurement Protocol hit. Mock ignores extra fields (05).
3. **Consent honoured server-side**: no hit for orders created without analytics consent.
4. **Later**: renewals, trial → paid conversions and refunds are only known to Backend. Not in the brief.

## Proposed extra events [P]

Not built. Marketing owns names; each needs approval. Each binds to one 04 transition and carries the common params.

| Event | Fires on (04) | Params | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identity_failed` | EidCallback → EidFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `expired` | Biggest drop-off we can't see today |
| `identity_rate_limited` | StartingEid → RateLimited | — | Provider capacity |
| `identity_error` | → StartError, → VerifyError, → OtherBrowser | `state` | Error rate per step |
| `payment_resumed` | Resume "Continue payment" | `transaction_id` | Explains a `purchase` without a fresh `payment_started` |
| `payment_failed` | → PaymentFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `declined`, `transaction_id` | Payment drop-off |
| `payment_unconfirmed` | Polling → Unconfirmed | `transaction_id` | Webhook latency (Q9) |

| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per page load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics) |
| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |

| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. Callback route uses `history.replace`, so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |
| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |

| Param | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |

| Param | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. URL is lowercase |
| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | From the URL path |

| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |

| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal clears it |

I drafted `spec/07-analytics.md` with all the sections you listed. Every event is tied to one transition in 04, and a whitelist of params per event keeps personal data out.

**Your findings checked:**
- **Six events, happy path only:** correct. Also, only `purchase` has params in the docs. The other five have none.
- **Purchase lost or sent twice:** correct, and there's more:
  - Q20's sessionStorage guard doesn't cover a return in a new tab. I changed it to a localStorage guard.
  - A second browser can still send `purchase` again.
  - In another browser the user gets a new GA client id, so the purchase counts as a new user.
- **`value`:** the order has no amount (Q4), and the docs don't say net or gross.
  - I snapshot the price into the open order at CreatingOrder, because `trialEligible` probably flips after payment.
  - `value` is the gross price (0 on trial), plus a `tax` param so marketing can get net. This is new Q46.
- **UTM redirects:** two, or three when the order needs `requires_action`. The return from a provider also counts as a GA4 referral and can take the campaign credit. Marketing needs to add the provider domains to "unwanted referrals" (new Q47).
- **Consent:** correct, there's no consent manager. I followed Q5: Consent Mode v2 basic. Before consent, events wait in memory and UTMs live only in the URL. After consent: sessionStorage for UTMs, localStorage for the guard.

**Calls I made you should check:**
- `purchase` is tied to entering Confirmed, not to one edge. 04 has four edges into Confirmed, and all of them mean `paid`.
- The auth callback uses `history.replace`, so `identity_completed` can't fire twice on Back. 04 doesn't say this yet.
- New custom params: `trial`, `tax`, `eid_purpose` (`checkout` or `reverify`), `identified`.

**Changed in `spec/03-open-questions.md`:** Q20's assumption (localStorage guard, `review_step` and UTMs added), and new Q46 and Q47.

lines: -# 07 · Analytics
-The GA4 events the flow sends through GTM, what they carry, and when they may be sent. Transitions refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`.
-Marks: **[D]** in `docs/04-analytics-notes.md` · **[A]** our rule · **[P]** proposed, not built.
-Out of the thin slice (PLAN.md). Built later as one module, below.
-## What the docs give us, and what they don't
-- Six events, names fixed by marketing ("keep names exactly as written") [D]. Happy path only: no event for a cancel, decline, error or timeout.
-- Only `purchase` has params: `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]. Nothing for the other five (Q20).

-- "UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`" [D]. No storage rule, and the flow leaves our origin once or twice: eID, then payment (plus `actionUrl` on `requires_action`). Return can land in another browser (Q7).
-- No consent mechanism (Q5). GA4 in the EU needs prior consent for analytics cookies.
-- `purchase` fired in the browser misses every user who never comes back from payment, and can fire twice (reload, second tab, second browser).
-- The order API returns no amount, currency or trial flag (Q4). `value` is our estimate.
-## Module
-One pure module, `analytics.ts`:
-- `track(event, params)`: typed map of the six events → their params. Unknown event = type error.
-- Adds the common params, checks consent, applies the once-rules, then `dataLayer.push`.
-- Components and state handlers call `track` on the transitions below. Nothing else touches `dataLayer`.
-- Unit-tested: params per event, once-rules, consent gate, no personal data.
-## Events
-Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.
-| Event [D] | Fires on (04) | Params (plus common) | Once-rule [A] |

-| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per page load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics) |
-| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |

-| `identity_started` | **StartingEid —201→ redirect to `redirectUrl`**. Not on click (may 429/fail) | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose`: `checkout` \| `reverify` (reverify = orderId in context, from IdentityLost) | Once per 201. Retry after EidFailed/RateLimited fires again: each is a real start |

-| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. Callback route uses `history.replace`, so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |

-| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |

-| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |

-Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback or after 500 ms, whichever first. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.
-### `purchase` params
-| Param | Value | Source |
-| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |

-| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
-| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
-| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
-| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
-| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |
-No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.
-Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).
-## Common params (every event)
-| Param | Value | Notes |
-| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. URL is lowercase |
-| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | From the URL path |
-| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
-| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |
-Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.
-### No personal data

-Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.
-## UTM capture and storage

-**Capture** [A]: on Entry, read `utm_*` from the landing URL. A new landing with any `utm_*` replaces the whole set (last campaign wins). A landing without UTMs keeps a stored set. Other query params are ignored (`gclid` etc. → proposals).
-**Carry**: two (three with `actionUrl`) cross-origin redirects, maybe into another browser (Q7).
-| Where | Before consent | After consent |
-| Memory (current page, client-side navigation) | yes | yes |
-| `returnUrl` query, eID and payment (Q7) | yes: URL, not storage (Q5) | yes |
-| `sessionStorage` (same tab, after a redirect) | no | yes |

-Trust order as 04 invariant 2: stored > `returnUrl` query. On return, the app reads UTMs from the query only when nothing is stored. Without consent, UTMs exist only in the URL, so they survive the redirects but not a manual reload of a page without them.

-`returnUrl` keeps the standard `utm_*` names. Side effect: the return page view re-states the campaign, so GA4 doesn't credit the eID or payment provider as a referral. Still needed from marketing: eID and payment domains in GA4 "unwanted referrals" (Q47).
-Limits: UTMs add to `returnUrl` length, and the provider/API limit is not documented (02). UTMs reach the eID and payment providers in the URL; they hold no personal data.
-## Consent
-Assumption Q5: GTM Consent Mode v2, basic mode (no Google tags before consent). CMP vendor unknown.
-| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |
-| Consent default | `gtag('consent', 'default', {analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization: 'denied'})` before GTM loads | `update` by the CMP | stays denied |
-| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
-| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
-| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal clears it |
-| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |
-- Queued events not flushed before a redirect are lost. Accepted: a CMP decision normally happens on Plans.
-- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
-- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
-- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
-- The CMP banner counts against the plan page budget (LCP, INP, JS size, Q22).
-## Known gaps of client-side events
-| Gap | Effect | Fix |
-| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (below) |

-| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side, deduped by `orderId` |
-| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side with the original client id |
-| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
-| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side for `purchase` |
-| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |
-## What must move server-side
-Requests to Backend + Marketing. Not built; client-side events stay until these exist.

-1. **`purchase` from the payment webhook** via GA4 Measurement Protocol, once per `orderId`, with the charged amount, tax, currency and trial flag (Q4). Then the client stops sending `purchase` (or sends it only as a fallback, deduped on `transaction_id`).

-2. **Attribution on the order**: `POST /v1/orders` also carries GA `client_id`, `session_id`, the consent state and UTMs (all omitted when consent is denied). Backend stores them with the order and uses them for the Measurement Protocol hit. Mock ignores extra fields (05).
-3. **Consent honoured server-side**: no hit for orders created without analytics consent.
-4. **Later**: renewals, trial → paid conversions and refunds are only known to Backend. Not in the brief.
-## Proposed extra events [P]
-Not built. Marketing owns names; each needs approval. Each binds to one 04 transition and carries the common params.
-| Event | Fires on (04) | Params | Why |
-| `identity_failed` | EidCallback → EidFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `expired` | Biggest drop-off we can't see today |
-| `identity_rate_limited` | StartingEid → RateLimited | — | Provider capacity |
-| `identity_error` | → StartError, → VerifyError, → OtherBrowser | `state` | Error rate per step |
-| `payment_resumed` | Resume "Continue payment" | `transaction_id` | Explains a `purchase` without a fresh `payment_started` |
-| `payment_failed` | → PaymentFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `declined`, `transaction_id` | Payment drop-off |
-| `payment_unconfirmed` | Polling → Unconfirmed | `transaction_id` | Webhook latency (Q9) |
-| `order_error` | CreatingOrder → retry point + error | `code` (adapter code, Q18) | Lost conversions from API errors |
-| `subscriber_redirected` | → Account | `from_state` | Existing subscribers landing on the flow (Q10) |
-| `gclid` / click ids on every event | Entry capture | `gclid` | Google Ads attribution, if marketing runs Ads (needs `ad_*` consent) |
-| `items[]` on `purchase` | — | `[{item_id: plan_id, price, quantity: 1}]` | GA4 ecommerce reports |
-Also derivable today, no new event: time `plan_viewed` → `purchase` for the "under two minutes" goal (Q22).

+| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
+| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
+| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal clears it |
+| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |
+- Queued events not flushed before a redirect are lost. Accepted: a CMP decision normally happens on Plans.
+- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
+- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
+- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
+- The CMP banner counts against the plan page budget (LCP, INP, JS size, Q22).
+## Known gaps of client-side events
+| Gap | Effect | Fix |
+| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (below) |

+| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side, deduped by `orderId` |
+| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side with the original client id |
+| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
+| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side for `purchase` |
+| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |
+## What must move server-side
+Requests to Backend + Marketing. Not built; client-side events stay until these exist.

+1. **`purchase` from the payment webhook** via GA4 Measurement Protocol, once per `orderId`, with the charged amount, tax, currency and trial flag (Q4). Then the client stops sending `purchase` (or sends it only as a fallback, deduped on `transaction_id`).

+2. **Attribution on the order**: `POST /v1/orders` also carries GA `client_id`, `session_id`, the consent state and UTMs (all omitted when consent is denied). Backend stores them with the order and uses them for the Measurement Protocol hit. Mock ignores extra fields (05).
+3. **Consent honoured server-side**: no hit for orders created without analytics consent.
+4. **Later**: renewals, trial → paid conversions and refunds are only known to Backend. Not in the brief.
+## Proposed extra events [P]
+Not built. Marketing owns names; each needs approval. Each binds to one 04 transition and carries the common params.
+| Event | Fires on (04) | Params | Why |
+| `identity_failed` | EidCallback → EidFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `expired` | Biggest drop-off we can't see today |
+| `identity_rate_limited` | StartingEid → RateLimited | — | Provider capacity |
+| `identity_error` | → StartError, → VerifyError, → OtherBrowser | `state` | Error rate per step |
+| `payment_resumed` | Resume "Continue payment" | `transaction_id` | Explains a `purchase` without a fresh `payment_started` |
+| `payment_failed` | → PaymentFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `declined`, `transaction_id` | Payment drop-off |
+| `payment_unconfirmed` | Polling → Unconfirmed | `transaction_id` | Webhook latency (Q9) |
+| `order_error` | CreatingOrder → retry point + error | `code` (adapter code, Q18) | Lost conversions from API errors |
+| `subscriber_redirected` | → Account | `from_state` | Existing subscribers landing on the flow (Q10) |
+| `gclid` / click ids on every event | Entry capture | `gclid` | Google Ads attribution, if marketing runs Ads (needs `ad_*` consent) |
+| `items[]` on `purchase` | — | `[{item_id: plan_id, price, quantity: 1}]` | GA4 ecommerce reports |
+Also derivable today, no new event: time `plan_viewed` → `purchase` for the "under two minutes" goal (Q22).

+# 07 · Analytics and quality
+Cross-cutting expectations: analytics and consent, i18n and URLs, accessibility, performance. Transitions refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`.
+Marks: **[D]** in `docs/` · **[A]** our rule · **[P]** proposed, not built.
+## Analytics
+The GA4 events the flow sends through GTM, what they carry, and when they may be sent. **[D]** here = `docs/04-analytics-notes.md`. Out of the thin slice (PLAN.md).
+### What the docs give us, and what they don't
+- Six events, names fixed by marketing ("keep names exactly as written") [D]. Happy path only: no event for a cancel, decline, error or timeout.
+- Only `purchase` has params: `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]. Nothing for the other five (Q20).

+- "UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`" [D]. No storage rule, and the flow leaves our origin once or twice: eID, then payment (plus `actionUrl` on `requires_action`). Return can land in another browser (Q7).
+- No consent mechanism (Q5). GA4 in the EU needs prior consent for analytics cookies.
+- `purchase` fired in the browser misses every user who never comes back from payment, and can fire twice (reload, second tab, second browser).
+- The order API returns no amount, currency or trial flag (Q4). `value` is our estimate.
+### Module
+One pure module, `analytics.ts`:
+- `track(event, params)`: typed map of the six events → their params. Unknown event = type error.
+- Adds the common params, checks consent, applies the once-rules, then `dataLayer.push`.
+- Components and state handlers call `track` on the transitions below. Nothing else touches `dataLayer`.
+- Unit-tested: params per event, once-rules, consent gate, no personal data.
+### Events
+Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.
+| Event [D] | Fires on (04) | Params (plus common) | Once-rule [A] |

+| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per page load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics) |
+| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |

+| `identity_started` | **StartingEid —201→ redirect to `redirectUrl`**. Not on click (may 429/fail) | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose`: `checkout` \| `reverify` (reverify = orderId in context, from IdentityLost) | Once per 201. Retry after EidFailed/RateLimited fires again: each is a real start |

+| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. EidCallback exits use `history.replace` (04), so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |

+| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |

+| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |

+Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback or after 500 ms, whichever first. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.
+#### `purchase` params
+| Param | Value | Source |
+| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |

+| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
+| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
+| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
+| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
+| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |
+No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.
+Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).
+### Common params (every event)
+| Param | Value | Notes |
+| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. URL is lowercase |
+| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | From the URL path |
+| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
+| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |
+Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.
+#### No personal data

+Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.
+### UTM capture and storage

## Checks

Every expectation below names its check. No check = not an expectation.

- **unit**: Vitest + Testing Library, next to the module.
- **e2e**: Playwright against the mock (`MOCK_TIME_SCALE=50`).
- **axe**: `@axe-core/playwright` inside e2e, rules `wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21aa, wcag22aa`, zero violations. New dev dependency: automated WCAG checks on every screen, the only way to cover all of them in CI.
- **Lighthouse**: Lighthouse CI, mobile preset (mid-range phone, 4× CPU throttle, slow 4G), median of 3 runs on the static build. New dev dependency: budgets fail the build.
- **build**: a script in `next build` (no dependency).
- **manual**: release checklist, VoiceOver iOS Safari + TalkBack Android Chrome, before each market launch.

## i18n and URLs

What the docs give: "Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian and English" [D brief], not 3 × 4. The CMS has one entry per market and language [D CMS]; fixtures have 6 pairs: local + `en` per market (Q24). No URL rule [D] (Q14).

### Routes

| Route | Pairs / rule | Check |
|---|---|---|
| `/{market}/{locale}/` (Plans), `/{market}/{locale}/review/` etc. | `ee/et`, `ee/en`, `lt/lt`, `lt/en`; `lv/lv`, `lv/en` only with `market.LV` on (Q13). Lowercase. `generateStaticParams` builds exactly these | build: page list = enabled pairs. e2e: each pair renders its CMS `headline` |
| `/auth/callback`, `/payment/return` | No market or locale in the path [D API, Mock]. Fixed by the provider allowlist (02) | e2e |
| `/` | Client redirect: first `navigator.languages` match among enabled pairs, else `/ee/et/`. Static export can't read `Accept-Language`, so Q14 is done client-side | unit (pick function), e2e |
| `<html lang>` | = locale on every page, callbacks included (set after context is read) | e2e |

### Fallback

| Input | Result | Check |
|---|---|---|
| Uppercase `/EE/ET/` | → `/ee/et/` | e2e |
| Valid market, unknown locale (`/ee/ru/`, `/ee/lv/`) | → `/{market}/{local}/` | unit, e2e |
| Unknown market, or LV with flag off | → `/` (04 Plans) | e2e |
| Anything else | `404.html` in the default locale, link to `/` | e2e |

Unknown paths are served `404.html` by the CDN. Its client script does the redirects above (no server, no middleware). One pure `resolvePair(market, locale, enabledPairs)` does all of it.

**Callbacks**: the path has no locale. Locale comes from stored context, else the `returnUrl` query (`market`, `locale`, which we add, 05), else the `/` rule (04 invariant 2). Query values are checked with `resolvePair`, never put into a path unchecked. Check: unit (each source), e2e (return with storage cleared → query locale; garbage query → `ee/et`).

### String ownership

| Source | Covers | Check |
|---|---|---|
| CMS (06) | Plans only: `headline`, `subhead`, card `title`/`bullets`/`badge`, `legalText`, FAQ | unit (parse), build (06 gate) |
| Our catalog `messages/{locale}.ts`, one per locale (`et`, `lv`, `lt`, `en`) | Everything else: buttons, "/ month", trial copy, Review, every 04 state message, polling status, errors, countdown, 404, `document.title` | unit: all catalogs have the same keys, no empty value. build: catalog keys = TypeScript type |
| CMP | Consent banner (vendor, Q5) | manual |

No hardcoded user-facing string in components. Check: lint rule (`react/jsx-no-literals`, existing ESLint plugin) in `npm run lint`. Catalog copy is ours until Marketing reviews it; the 4 catalogs need translation before launch (Q48).

### Formatting

| What | How | Check |
|---|---|---|
| Money | `Intl.NumberFormat(tag, {style:'currency', currency})` on `Math.round(priceNet*(1+vatRate))/100` (Q2). `et` → `11,15 €`, `en` → `€11.15` | unit, one case per locale |
| Dates (trial end, if shown) | `Intl.DateTimeFormat(tag, {dateStyle:'long', timeZone})`. Zones: `Europe/Tallinn`, `Europe/Riga`, `Europe/Vilnius` | unit |
| Counts ("Try again in N s") | `Intl.PluralRules(tag)`. `lt` has `one/few/many/other`, `lv` has `zero/one/other` | unit for 0, 1, 2, 5, 11, 21 |
| Tag | `et`, `lv`, `lt`; `en` → `en-150` (`en-EE` falls back to US style "December 10") (Q48) | unit |

## Accessibility

Target WCAG 2.2 AA (Q21). Not in the brief, but the European Accessibility Act (in force since 28 June 2025) covers e-commerce and audiovisual services for consumers in the EU; it points to EN 301 549 = WCAG 2.1 AA, which 2.2 AA includes. Provider pages are out of our control.

| Expectation | Check |
|---|---|
| Every screen (Plans, Review, every 04 state, 404, both callbacks): one `<h1>`, landmarks, `lang`, unique `document.title` per state | axe on each screen in e2e |
| Plans: each card is an `<article>` with its title as heading; select button name includes the plan ("Choose Standard"), price read as text, not split | unit, axe |
| Step change (client-side): focus moves to the new `<h1>` (`tabindex="-1"`), title updates. Back/restore from bfcache: same (04 invariant 6) | unit, e2e |
| Async status (Verifying, Gate, Polling, RateLimited) in one `aria-live="polite"` region. Announce only when the text changes ("Still confirming", "Connection issue"), not each poll or second. Countdown: announced at start and when "Try again" enables | unit (text changes only on state change), manual |
| Before a redirect (eID, payment, `actionUrl`): button text says the user leaves the site ("Continue to eID"). On click, live region "Opening …", redirect after ≤ 500 ms (same wait as analytics, 07) | unit, manual |
| Keyboard only: whole happy path with Tab/Enter/Space, no trap, logical order, visible focus (≥ 2px, 3:1 contrast) | e2e (keyboard-only happy path), manual |
| Errors: blocking error in a banner that gets focus; field errors (Review consent checkbox) via `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`. Text says what happened and what to do; color is never the only signal | unit, axe |
| Target size: 44 × 44 px minimum for every control (stricter than 2.5.8's 24 px) | e2e (bounding box of every button/link ≥ 44) |
| Disabled buttons in flight: `aria-disabled` + busy text, so focus stays on them | unit |
| Contrast 4.5:1 text, 3:1 UI; reflow at 320 px and 200 % zoom; `prefers-reduced-motion` stops spinners | axe (contrast), e2e (320 px no horizontal scroll), manual (zoom) |

## Performance

70 % of traffic on phones, "under two minutes" [D brief], no budgets (Q22). Budgets apply to the Plans page (entry, where most users bounce), on the Lighthouse mobile preset.

| Metric | Budget | Check |
|---|---|---|
| LCP | < 2.5 s | Lighthouse |
| CLS | < 0.1 | Lighthouse; e2e: no layout shift entry > 0 after `/v1/me` resolves |
| INP | < 200 ms. Lab proxy: TBT < 200 ms | Lighthouse (TBT); field INP via `web-vitals` is a proposal (needs a GA event, marketing approval) |
| JS | ≤ 150 KB gzip first load on Plans, GTM and CMP excluded (their own budget: loaded after hydration) | build (sum of route chunks) |
| Flow time | `plan_viewed` → `purchase` median < 2 min | GA (after launch, analytics above) |

### What Plans may wait for

- **Nothing at runtime for first paint.** Headline, cards and prices are in the HTML (CMS + `/v1/plans` at build, Q23). Check: e2e with the API blocked → cards and prices visible.
- `/v1/me` runs after hydration and never blocks paint. Trial copy is only on Review (04), so its answer moves nothing on Plans. An active subscriber sees Plans briefly, then redirects (Q10). Check: e2e.
- Resume banner (open order) is a sticky overlay, not inserted above the cards. Check: e2e CLS entry.
- GTM and CMP load `afterInteractive`; the banner is an overlay, never the LCP element. Check: Lighthouse LCP element = `<h1>` or first card.
- Fonts: system stack, or one self-hosted font with `font-display: swap` + `size-adjust`. No hero image. Check: Lighthouse.

### How SSG closes the gap

Each pair is static HTML on the CDN: low TTFB, LCP element in the first response, no client fetch before paint. The remaining cost is hydration, so Plans is a server component; only the select buttons and the flow controller are client code. Polling, Review and callbacks are their own routes, split out of the Plans bundle. Check: build (JS budget), Lighthouse.

I renamed the file to `spec/07-analytics-and-quality.md` and added four sections after Analytics: Checks, i18n and URLs, Accessibility, Performance. The new part is 97 lines. Every expectation names its check (unit, e2e, axe, Lighthouse, build or manual). The `PLAN.md` row 1.8 points to the new name.

**Your findings checked:**
- **3 markets × 4 languages:** not quite. The brief only lists four languages and doesn't say every market gets all four. Q24 already assumes local + English per market, which matches the 6 fixture pairs.
- **No locale in callback URLs:** half right. `/auth/callback` and `/payment/return` have no locale in the path, but our `returnUrl` query carries `market` and `locale` (05, Q7). Order used: stored context, then the query (checked against the valid pairs), then the root rule.
- **CMS covers only the plan page:** correct. Everything else comes from our catalogs, plus the consent banner text from the consent tool's vendor.
- **Accessibility:** correct. The European Accessibility Act has applied since 28 June 2025. It points to WCAG 2.1 AA, and our 2.2 AA target includes that.
- **Performance:** correct. Q22 had LCP, INP and the JS limit. I added CLS < 0.1 and TBT < 200 ms, since INP can't be measured in Lighthouse lab runs.

**New things I found:**
- Q14 says the root redirects by `Accept-Language`, but a static export can't read that header. I changed it to a client-side redirect using `navigator.languages`.
- Unknown URLs need the CDN to serve `404.html`, with a script that does the redirects. There's no server or middleware to do it.
- `Intl` with `en` or `en-EE` gives US style ("December 10, 2026"). My assumption is `en-150` ("10 December 2026"), logged as Q48.
- Lithuanian and Latvian have extra plural forms, so countdown text uses `Intl.PluralRules`.
- The Resume banner on Plans would shift the layout, so it's a sticky overlay instead.

**Changed in `spec/03-open-questions.md`:** Q14 (client-side redirect), Q21 (Accessibility Act), Q22 (CLS and TBT), and new Q48 (who writes our strings in four languages; English format).

**New dev dependencies, reasons in the spec:** `@axe-core/playwright` and Lighthouse CI. The no-hardcoded-strings rule uses `react/jsx-no-literals`, which comes with the ESLint React plugin.

1	# 07 · Analytics and quality
     2	
     3	Cross-cutting expectations: analytics and consent, i18n and URLs, accessibility, performance. Transitions refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`.
     4	
     5	Marks: **[D]** in `docs/` · **[A]** our rule · **[P]** proposed, not built.
     6	
     7	## Analytics
     8	
     9	The GA4 events the flow sends through GTM, what they carry, and when they may be sent. **[D]** here = `docs/04-analytics-notes.md`. Out of the thin slice (PLAN.md).
    10	
    11	### What the docs give us, and what they don't
    12	
    13	- Six events, names fixed by marketing ("keep names exactly as written") [D]. Happy path only: no event for a cancel, decline, error or timeout.
    14	- Only `purchase` has params: `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]. Nothing for the other five (Q20).
    15	- "UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`" [D]. No storage rule, and the flow leaves our origin once or twice: eID, then payment (plus `actionUrl` on `requires_action`). Return can land in another browser (Q7).
    16	- No consent mechanism (Q5). GA4 in the EU needs prior consent for analytics cookies.
    17	- `purchase` fired in the browser misses every user who never comes back from payment, and can fire twice (reload, second tab, second browser).
    18	- The order API returns no amount, currency or trial flag (Q4). `value` is our estimate.
    19	
    20	### Module
    21	
    22	One pure module, `analytics.ts`:
    23	
    24	- `track(event, params)`: typed map of the six events → their params. Unknown event = type error.
    25	- Adds the common params, checks consent, applies the once-rules, then `dataLayer.push`.
    26	- Components and state handlers call `track` on the transitions below. Nothing else touches `dataLayer`.
    27	- Unit-tested: params per event, once-rules, consent gate, no personal data.
    28	
    29	### Events
    30	
    31	Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.
    32	
    33	| Event [D] | Fires on (04) | Params (plus common) | Once-rule [A] |
    34	|---|---|---|---|
    35	| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per page load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics) |
    36	| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |
    37	| `identity_started` | **StartingEid —201→ redirect to `redirectUrl`**. Not on click (may 429/fail) | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose`: `checkout` \| `reverify` (reverify = orderId in context, from IdentityLost) | Once per 201. Retry after EidFailed/RateLimited fires again: each is a real start |
    38	| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. EidCallback exits use `history.replace` (04), so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |
    39	| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |
    40	| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |
    41	
    42	Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback or after 500 ms, whichever first. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.
    43	
    44	#### `purchase` params
    45	
    46	| Param | Value | Source |
    47	|---|---|---|
    48	| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |
    49	| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
    50	| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
    51	| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
    52	| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
    53	| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |
    54	
    55	No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.
    56	
    57	Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).
    58	
    59	### Common params (every event)
    60	
    61	| Param | Value | Notes |
    62	|---|---|---|
    63	| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. URL is lowercase |
    64	| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | From the URL path |
    65	| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
    66	| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |
    67	
    68	Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.
    69	
    70	#### No personal data
    71	
    72	Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.
    73	
    74	### UTM capture and storage
    75	
    76	**Capture** [A]: on Entry, read `utm_*` from the landing URL. A new landing with any `utm_*` replaces the whole set (last campaign wins). A landing without UTMs keeps a stored set. Other query params are ignored (`gclid` etc. → proposals).
    77	
    78	**Carry**: two (three with `actionUrl`) cross-origin redirects, maybe into another browser (Q7).
    79	
    80	| Where | Before consent | After consent |
    81	|---|---|---|
    82	| Memory (current page, client-side navigation) | yes | yes |
    83	| `returnUrl` query, eID and payment (Q7) | yes: URL, not storage (Q5) | yes |
    84	| `sessionStorage` (same tab, after a redirect) | no | yes |
    85	
    86	Trust order as 04 invariant 2: stored > `returnUrl` query. On return, the app reads UTMs from the query only when nothing is stored. Without consent, UTMs exist only in the URL, so they survive the redirects but not a manual reload of a page without them.
    87	
    88	`returnUrl` keeps the standard `utm_*` names. Side effect: the return page view re-states the campaign, so GA4 doesn't credit the eID or payment provider as a referral. Still needed from marketing: eID and payment domains in GA4 "unwanted referrals" (Q47).
    89	
    90	Limits: UTMs add to `returnUrl` length, and the provider/API limit is not documented (02). UTMs reach the eID and payment providers in the URL; they hold no personal data.
    91	
    92	### Consent
    93	
    94	Assumption Q5: GTM Consent Mode v2, basic mode (no Google tags before consent). CMP vendor unknown.
    95	
    96	| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |
    97	|---|---|---|---|
    98	| Consent default | `gtag('consent', 'default', {analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization: 'denied'})` before GTM loads | `update` by the CMP | stays denied |
    99	| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
   100	| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
   101	| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal clears it |
   102	| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |
   103	
   104	- Queued events not flushed before a redirect are lost. Accepted: a CMP decision normally happens on Plans.
   105	- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
   106	- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
   107	- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
   108	- The CMP banner counts against the plan page budget (LCP, INP, JS size, Q22).
   109	
   110	### Known gaps of client-side events
   111	
   112	| Gap | Effect | Fix |
   113	|---|---|---|
   114	| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (below) |
   115	| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side, deduped by `orderId` |
   116	| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side with the original client id |
   117	| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
   118	| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side for `purchase` |
   119	| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |
   120	
   121	### What must move server-side
   122	
   123	Requests to Backend + Marketing. Not built; client-side events stay until these exist.
   124	
   125	1. **`purchase` from the payment webhook** via GA4 Measurement Protocol, once per `orderId`, with the charged amount, tax, currency and trial flag (Q4). Then the client stops sending `purchase` (or sends it only as a fallback, deduped on `transaction_id`).
   126	2. **Attribution on the order**: `POST /v1/orders` also carries GA `client_id`, `session_id`, the consent state and UTMs (all omitted when consent is denied). Backend stores them with the order and uses them for the Measurement Protocol hit. Mock ignores extra fields (05).
   127	3. **Consent honoured server-side**: no hit for orders created without analytics consent.
   128	4. **Later**: renewals, trial → paid conversions and refunds are only known to Backend. Not in the brief.
   129	
   130	### Proposed extra events [P]
   131	
   132	Not built. Marketing owns names; each needs approval. Each binds to one 04 transition and carries the common params.
   133	
   134	| Event | Fires on (04) | Params | Why |
   135	|---|---|---|---|
   136	| `identity_failed` | EidCallback → EidFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `expired` | Biggest drop-off we can't see today |
   137	| `identity_rate_limited` | StartingEid → RateLimited | — | Provider capacity |
   138	| `identity_error` | → StartError, → VerifyError, → OtherBrowser | `state` | Error rate per step |
   139	| `payment_resumed` | Resume "Continue payment" | `transaction_id` | Explains a `purchase` without a fresh `payment_started` |
   140	| `payment_failed` | → PaymentFailed | `reason`: `cancelled` \| `declined`, `transaction_id` | Payment drop-off |
   141	| `payment_unconfirmed` | Polling → Unconfirmed | `transaction_id` | Webhook latency (Q9) |
   142	| `order_error` | CreatingOrder → retry point + error | `code` (adapter code, Q18) | Lost conversions from API errors |
   143	| `subscriber_redirected` | → Account | `from_state` | Existing subscribers landing on the flow (Q10) |
   144	| `gclid` / click ids on every event | Entry capture | `gclid` | Google Ads attribution, if marketing runs Ads (needs `ad_*` consent) |
   145	| `items[]` on `purchase` | — | `[{item_id: plan_id, price, quantity: 1}]` | GA4 ecommerce reports |
   146	
   147	Also derivable today, no new event: time `plan_viewed` → `purchase` for the "under two minutes" goal (Q22).
   148	
   149	## Checks
   150

    29	### Events
    30	
    31	Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.
    32	
    33	| Event [D] | Fires on (04) | Params (plus common) | Once-rule [A] |
    34	|---|---|---|---|
    35	| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per page load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics) |
    36	| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |
    37	| `identity_started` | **StartingEid —201→ redirect to `redirectUrl`**. Not on click (may 429/fail) | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose`: `checkout` \| `reverify` (reverify = orderId in context, from IdentityLost) | Once per 201. Retry after EidFailed/RateLimited fires again: each is a real start |
    38	| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. EidCallback exits use `history.replace` (04), so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |
    39	| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |
    40	| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |
    41	
    42	Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback or after 500 ms, whichever first. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.
    43	
    44	#### `purchase` params
    45	
    46	| Param | Value | Source |
    47	|---|---|---|
    48	| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |
    49	| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
    50	| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
    51	| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
    52	| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
    53	| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |
    54	
    55	No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.
    56	
    57	Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).
    58	
    59	### Common params (every event)
    60	
    61	| Param | Value | Notes |
    62	|---|---|---|
    63	| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. URL is lowercase |
    64	| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | From the URL path |
    65	| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
    66	| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |
    67	
    68	Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.
    69	
    70	#### No personal data
    71	
    72	Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.
    73	
    74	### UTM capture and storage
    75	
    76	**Capture** [A]: on Entry, read `utm_*` from the landing URL. A new landing with any `utm_*` replaces the whole set (last campaign wins). A landing without UTMs keeps a stored set. Other query params are ignored (`gclid` etc. → proposals).
    77	
    78	**Carry**: two (three with `actionUrl`) cross-origin redirects, maybe into another browser (Q7).
    79	
    80	| Where | Before consent | After consent |
    81	|---|---|---|
    82	| Memory (current page, client-side navigation) | yes | yes |
    83	| `returnUrl` query, eID and payment (Q7) | yes: URL, not storage (Q5) | yes |
    84	| `sessionStorage` (same tab, after a redirect) | no | yes |
    85	
    86	Trust order as 04 invariant 2: stored > `returnUrl` query. On return, the app reads UTMs from the query only when nothing is stored. Without consent, UTMs exist only in the URL, so they survive the redirects but not a manual reload of a page without them.
    87	
    88	`returnUrl` keeps the standard `utm_*` names. Side effect: the return page view re-states the campaign, so GA4 doesn't credit the eID or payment provider as a referral. Still needed from marketing: eID and payment domains in GA4 "unwanted referrals" (Q47).
    89	
    90	Limits: UTMs add to `returnUrl` length, and the provider/API limit is not documented (02). UTMs reach the eID and payment providers in the URL; they hold no personal data.
    91	
    92	### Consent
    93	
    94	Assumption Q5: GTM Consent Mode v2, basic mode (no Google tags before consent). CMP vendor unknown.
    95	
    96	| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |
    97	|---|---|---|---|
    98	| Consent default | `gtag('consent', 'default', {analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization: 'denied'})` before GTM loads | `update` by the CMP | stays denied |
    99	| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
   100	| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
   101	| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal clears it |
   102	| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |
   103	
   104	- Queued events not flushed before a redirect are lost. Accepted: a CMP decision normally happens on Plans.
   105	- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
   106	- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
   107	- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
   108	- The CMP banner counts against the plan page budget (LCP, INP, JS size, Q22).
   109	
   110	### Known gaps of client-side events
   111	
   112	| Gap | Effect | Fix |
   113	|---|---|---|
   114	| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (below) |
   115	| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side, deduped by `orderId` |
   116	| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side with the original client id |
   117	| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
   118	| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side for `purchase` |
   119	| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |
   120

   122	
   123	Requests to Backend + Marketing. Not built; client-side events stay until these exist.
   124	
   125	1. **`purchase` from the payment webhook** via GA4 Measurement Protocol, once per `orderId`, with the charged amount, tax, currency and trial flag (Q4). Then the client stops sending `purchase` (or sends it only as a fallback, deduped on `transaction_id`).

   127	3. **Consent honoured server-side**: no hit for orders created without analytics consent.
   128	4. **Later**: renewals, trial → paid conversions and refunds are only known to Backend. Not in the brief.

   132	Not built. Marketing owns names; each needs approval. Each binds to one 04 transition and carries the common params.

# Nordlight assignment: starter repository

Start with [`ASSIGNMENT.md`](ASSIGNMENT.md). It explains what to deliver and the ground rules.

## What is in here

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `ASSIGNMENT.md` | The brief: scenario, deliverables, ground rules |
| `docs/` | Product brief, API notes, CMS content model, analytics notes |
